images.alt: Map of the South Island of Aotearoa New Zealand with strong wind watch areas highlighted in yellow. A heading at the top reads "MetService Strong Wind Watches Issued: Wednesday 20 May". A legend on the right shows a red triangle icon labelled "Red Warning", an orange hexagon icon labelled "Orange Warning", and a yellow circle icon labelled "Watch". Fiordland, Southland, Otago and Stewart Island are highlighted yellow, with a yellow circle icon with a wind symbol in the centre, and a label reading "10pm Wednesday 20 May to 10am Thursday 21 May". Canterbury High Country is highlighted yellow, with a yellow circle icon with a wind symbol in the centre, and a label reading "3am to 3pm Thursday 21 May".

Map of the South Island of Aotearoa New Zealand with heavy rain watch areas highlighted in yellow. A heading at the top reads "MetService Heavy Rain Watches Issued: Wednesday 20 May". A legend on the right shows a red triangle icon labelled "Red Warning", an orange hexagon icon labelled "Orange Warning", and a yellow circle icon labelled "Watch". Fiordland north of Doubtful Sound is highlighted yellow, with a yellow circle icon with a rain symbol in the centre, and a label reading "midnight Wednesday 20 May to noon Thursday 21 May". The ranges of Westland are highlighted yellow, with a yellow circle icon with a rain symbol in the centre, and a label reading "6am to midnight Thursday 21 May".

post.text:
🟡 Watches for strong wind and heavy rain have been issued for a front sweeping up the South Island tomorrow (Thursday 20 May).

💨 Strong Wind: Fiordland, Southland, Otago and Canterbury High Country.

🌧️ Heavy Rain: Fiordland north of Doubtful Sound, and the ranges of Westland.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
